2364-5660-6769-6798.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2364-5660-6769-6798.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mana Vault, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

222-527-6797-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6797-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5434-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-5434-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

855-5231-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-2033-3249-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

333-4775-6495.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4775-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
333-4775-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-1636-7519-7875.description:
Cast Demonic Tutor using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Woe.
When Emeritus of Woe enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2557-5660-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

240-5147-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2438-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-2438-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3480-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

955-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
955-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-2506-2719-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-5205-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-5223.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-3306.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Slip On the Ring.
141-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Slip On the Ring, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Slip On the Ring, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-4740-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2921-4740-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2921-4740-5220-6900.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

1069-1374-3499-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-3499-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

2060-2265-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Hardened Scales.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

103-553.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact, enchantment and/or token.
103-553.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Farsight Ritual by paying {2}{U}{U} and sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token, causing you to look at the top eight cards of your library, put Approach of the Second Sun and any other card into your hand and put the rest on the bottom of your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

643-1560-1909-2290.description:
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning itself to your hand, untapping any creature.
Pay 2 life to cast Wirewood Symbiote.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder to activate it, gaining 2 life.
Resolve Wirewood Symbiote.
Repeat.

628-2060-2438.description:
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 until Crystalline Crawler has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crystalline Crawler.
Crystalline Crawler dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-3910-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Breya, adding {C}{C}.
When Breya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Breya from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Breya enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
